attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 25 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and it is the only Procopius saint.gr prints on that day. The identification rests on the day, the name and the rank of martyr alone: the folder's Romanian source, doxologia.ro, printed «Sfântul Mucenic Procopie» and no life whatever — no country, no century, no manner of death — so there is nothing in it to check against the Greek page's new martyr of Smyrna, and nothing in it that contradicts him either. The corpus's other Procopii are kept on other days. Recorded as one man on that ground and flagged in the reader's report; the Greek page's own particulars are given to the Greek page in the life. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (24 September 2026).
